question: Could you provide the annual percentage shares, rounded to two decimal places, of the top 5 minor crime categories from 2008 in London's total crimes, with each year displayed in one row?
sql:
WITH top5_2008 AS (
  SELECT minor_category
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa`
  WHERE year = 2008
  GROUP BY minor_category
  ORDER BY SUM(value) DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
category_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.year,
    c.minor_category,
    SUM(c.value) as cat_total
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa` c
  JOIN top5_2008 t5 ON c.minor_category = t5.minor_category
  GROUP BY c.year, c.minor_category
),
year_totals AS (
  SELECT year, SUM(cat_total) as total_top5
  FROM category_counts
  GROUP BY year
),
all_year_totals AS (
  SELECT year, SUM(value) as total_crimes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa`
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
  yt.year,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(yt.total_top5, ayt.total_crimes) * 100, 2) as percentage_share
FROM year_totals yt
JOIN all_year_totals ayt ON yt.year = ayt.year
ORDER BY yt.year
